title: How to Use LinkedIn's "Open to Work" Banner for Your Job Search
description:
When you’re job searching you want to give yourself every opportunity for success! Using the “open to work” banner on LinkedIn is a great way to show the LinkedIn community that you are looking for work, and ready to join their team.
